LanguageData.HE_Nord_Hearth.label: longhouse hearth
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Hearth.description: A long fire pit lined with stones. It heats a large hall, lights it, and keeps a pot of stew warm.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_RuneStone.label: rune stone
LanguageData.HE_Nord_RuneStone.description: A tall grey stone carved with a serpent of runes that tells of a hero's deeds.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_ShieldWall.label: round shield display
LanguageData.HE_Nord_ShieldWall.description: A painted round shield with an iron boss, hung where everyone can see it.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_MeadTable.label: mead table
LanguageData.HE_Nord_MeadTable.description: A long oak table set with drinking horns and a bowl of mead. Colonists gather here to drink and boast.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Sauna.label: sauna
LanguageData.HE_Nord_Sauna.description: A small pine bath house with a stone stove and benches. Colonists sweat out their worries here.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BowLoft_Gun.label: twin bow
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BowLoft_Gun.description: The turning top of the bow loft.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BowLoft.label: bow loft
LanguageData.HE_Nord_BowLoft.description: A log platform with a huge twin bow on a pivot, the kind that once guarded the fjord gates. It shoots two great arrows at a time over long range. Wood for new arrows: one log makes two.
LanguageData.HE_Nord_ElectricForge.label: electric forge
LanguageData.HE_Nord_ElectricForge.description: A forge with an electric blower, a power hammer and an anvil worn smooth by generations. It makes everything a smithy makes, 25% faster.
